remarks: Discover the perfect blend of modern comfort and serene living at 29 Lancaster Place! This stunning completely renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom high ranch offers everything you've been searching for in an ideal Stamford location with over 3000 sq ft of living space. Nestled on a desirable cul-de-sac, this home provides the tranquility of suburban living with minimal through traffic, making it perfect for families and those seeking a peaceful retreat. Step into the heart of the home where the renovated kitchen, living room, and dining room flow seamlessly together, creating the perfect open-concept space for both everyday living and entertaining guests. Enjoy effortless transitions from the main living areas through stylish sliders onto your brand-new spacious deck, where you can relax while overlooking your own private backyard oasis. The thoughtful layout combines modern amenities with the timeless charm of ranch-style living. Experience the best of Stamford living with convenient access to excellent dining options, shopping destinations, and the Metro-North train station for easy commuting to New York City and beyond. With its complete renovations, spacious layout, and unbeatable location, 29 Lancaster Place represents a rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home where the private yard and new deck provide the perfect backdrop for summer barbecues, morning coffee, or simply unwinding after a busy day. Don't miss your chance to make this exceptional property home
